description: Central and Northern California Ocean Observing System (CeNCOOS) | An IOOS Regional Data Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Integrated Ocean Observing System | Federal Partners; Integrated Ocean Observing System | Regional Associations; CeNCOOS Members and Partners. The Central and Northern California Ocean Observing System (CeNCOOS) helps users convert coastal and oceanic data into actionable climate planning. The site provides real-time and forecasted information and regional datasets on algae, wind speed, turbidity, temperatures, and more. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Vector-Borne Disease. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
